prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Spanish woman — the personification of Barcelona — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Barcelona as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the splash pool at the foot of tall twisting water slides, spray hanging in the sun and a shallow ledge to climb out on
Season: autumn — October to December, the rainiest season, mild days broken by long spells of rain.
Time of day: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet; a pale lilac sky, mist low on the ground.
Hair: her hair wet and slicked back or dripping — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Small moment: a dusting of pale sand clings to her knees and calves.
Outfit: a bikini with draped cups knotted at the centre and draped bikini bottoms gathered at the hips — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a high-waisted line, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
PROP: with both hands she aims a carved wooden water squirter playfully toward the camera — her own right hand finger on the trigger, her own left hand supports the barrel.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a tuning fork of gold with a faint ring of light humming around its tines — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

observations: Landscape composition, complete figure, carved wooden water squirter and two hands are visible.
Side view follows the plan; water slides are interpreted as tile and stone channels.
